exposure.needed: whether any Kafka clusters in the environment are still ZooKeeper-based rather than KRaft; the evidence does not state how ZooKeeper-based clusters are identified in the cluster configuration

consequence.statement: An environment still running ZooKeeper-based clusters must move them to KRaft before upgrading, because Strimzi 0.46.0 no longer supports ZooKeeper-based clusters or the ZooKeeper-to-KRaft migration.
consequence.remediation: Migrate every ZooKeeper-based cluster to KRaft before upgrading to Strimzi 0.46.0 or newer.

assertion.statement: Strimzi 0.46.0 removes support for ZooKeeper-based clusters and for migrating ZooKeeper-based clusters to KRaft, so all clusters must already be using KRaft before upgrading to 0.46.0 or newer.
